mapper.select: SELECT io.value AS forward_per, io.observation_date, io.source_url, io.collected_at, ic.provider, ic.license_status, avg_10y.avg_per AS avg_per_10y FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AVG(io2.value) AS avg_per FROM indicator_catalog ic2 JOIN indicator_observation io2 ON ic2.id = io2.indicator_id WHERE ic2.code = 'FORWARD_PER' AND io2.observation_date >= date('now', '-10 years') ) avg_10y ON 1=1 WHERE ic.code = 'FORWARD_PER' ORDER BY io.observation_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT io.observation_date, io.value AS forward_per FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code = 'FORWARD_PER' ORDER BY io.observation_date

SELECT io.value AS forward_per, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code = 'FORWARD_PER' GROUP BY ROUND(io.value, 0) ORDER BY forward_per
mapper.insert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO indicator_observation (indicator_id, observation_date, published_at, value, vintage, source_url, collected_at) VALUES ( (SELECT id FROM indicator_catalog WHERE code = #{code}), #{observation_date}, #{published_at}, #{value}, 'latest', #{source_url}, datetime('now', 'localtime') )
INSERT INTO ingestion_job (source, started_at, ended_at, status, rows_written, error) VALUES (#{source}, #{started_at}, datetime('now', 'localtime'), #{status}, #{rows_written}, #{error})
